newsitem.title: USA: SANTA FE BUYS ANDERSON ARGENTINE PROPERTIES.
newsitem.headline: SANTA FE BUYS ANDERSON ARGENTINE PROPERTIES.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said that it has purchased Anderson Exploration Ltd interests in the Tupungato field in Argentina and interests in exploratory concessions in the Neuquen Basin for $35 million net of working capital.

Santa Fe said current net production from the Tupungato properties, where it will have a 100 percent interest, is 1,250 barrels of oil per day and is expected to increase to almost 2,500 bopd through development drilling and waterflood projects over the next two years.

The undeveloped acreage, where it will have a non-operating interest, is located in the northern and central parts of the Neuquen Basin where Santa Fe has existing gas production and operations in the Sierra Chata field.

"The acquisition from Anderson reflects our strategy to grow our Argentina asset base by adding production with development potential and exploratory opportunities," said James Payne, Santa Fe's chief executive, in a statement.
